task: Add docker-images-prod.s3.dualstack.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:443 to the harden-runner allowed-endpoints of the three Air-Gap E2E jobs in .github/workflows/e2e-airgap.yaml so Docker Hub image pulls stop timing out on AWS-hosted runners.

events.summary: Only .github/workflows/e2e-airgap.yaml (three allowed-endpoints lists, one added line each) and this trace change. Not touched: scripts, production Go code, charts, action pins, any other endpoint.

Two Air-Gap E2E jobs on AWS-hosted runners failed pulling from Docker Hub with 'error pulling image configuration: download failed after attempts=6: dial tcp 54.185.253.63:443: i/o timeout': run 43844467445 attempt 1 (k3s leg, docker pull busybox:1.36) and run 44701070172 job 136169310769 (kind xfs leg, kind create cluster pulling kindest/node:v1.32.2). The harden-runner report of the second run lists 'domain not allowed: docker-images-prod.s3.dualstack.us-east-1.amazonaws.com.'. Every passing run observed was on an Azure runner.

Added docker-images-prod.s3.dualstack.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:443 after production.cloudfront.docker.com:443 in the allowed-endpoints of the matrix, k3s and ganesha jobs. That the blocked host is the cause of the timeout is inferred from the block report and the shared failure signature.
Static verification only: the workflow diff is three added lines, make verify rc=0. The fix is not yet confirmed on an AWS runner because the runner cloud cannot be selected.
